description: The image displays two pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), illustrating the co-occurrence frequencies of different tokens with the word "reaction" in two distinct domains: chemistry (chart a) and mathematics (chart b). Chart (a) is divided into six segments, each with a unique pattern and percentage: a dark blue hatched segment labeled “the” at 31%, a light blue hatched segment labeled “this” at 21%, a green cross-hatched segment labeled “for” at 17%, a green grid-patterned segment labeled “chemical” at 15%, a yellow textured segment labeled “to” at 9%, and a light blue striped segment labeled “in” at 7%. Chart (b) is divided into four segments, each with a unique color and percentage: a dark blue hatched segment labeled “the” at 38%, a pink dotted segment labeled “$” at 27%, a yellow textured segment labeled “equilibrium” at 19%, and a gray dotted segment labeled “constatant” at 15%. Both charts include legends mapping the patterns/colors to their respective token labels, and each slice is clearly labeled with its corresponding percentage value inside the segment. The segments in both charts are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest slice at the top right and proceeding clockwise.
